doc: cumulus_max = 1, a_fine = 1, fine up to +-1.6 and a sub-texel std of 3 (n_clouds = 1/9, outside the pipeline range on purpose): both the first clip (density (1 + a_fine fine) outside [0, 1]) and the one after the binomial term are taken at 0 and at 1; the first row holds fine = -1, 0, +1 at density exactly 1, where c is exactly 0 or 1 and sqrt(c (1 - c)) is 0. float32 fields, float64 threshold column, output float64; tolerance is the default float32 band with frac = 0.005 (the sqrt makes a few texels ill-conditioned, see the measurement). Arguments: s, fine, t, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted t, streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads (the others keep their defaults). params.result_dtype ("f64" or "f32") is the dtype numpy gives the result by promotion (a float64 t array or float64 inputs give f64, a python-float t with float32 fields keeps f32); it is informational, the stored output has that dtype. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.4e-6; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 5.7e-5 (worst of 6 random trials); 0.05% of the elements leave the default band in the worst trial (the sqrt of c (1 - c) has an infinite slope where c reaches 0 or 1), so frac = 0.005 is 10x that.
